questions.q: How can you prepare a soluble salt (such as copper sulfate) using an excess of an insoluble base (copper oxide) and an acid?

questions.q: What method is used to prepare an insoluble salt (such as barium sulfate or silver chloride)?
a: Precipitation (mixing two soluble salt solutions, filtering, washing, and drying the solid)
